The vertical axis, labeled “Overall Performance (%)”, presents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, with tick marks at 10-unit intervals.  Each category is represented by a single bar with a gray-green color, with bar heights corresponding to performance percentages. The tallest bar, representing the category 76-24, reaches approximately 76.24%, while the shortest bar, representing the category 34-24, reaches approximately 34.24%.  The bars are arranged by tier, with Tier-1 represented by the first two bars (72-77%), Tier-2 represented by bars three through six (64-68%), and Tier-3 represented by bars seven through ten (34-46%).
